scope: Configure message lifecycle dependencies and initial settings through constructor functional options
acceptance_criteria: One NewMessageLifecycle constructor accepts MessageOption values
Initial ID, mode, interruption setting, sender, packet sink, dispatcher, expiry routing, and behavior loader are constructor options
No separate context constructor or post-construction dependency setters remain
Behavior loading waits until Initialize after deployment configuration becomes available
Runtime SetMode remains a state transition; event calls no longer accept dependency callbacks
Preserve text-mode and disabled-interruption defaults, callback ordering, held-input replay, and completion guards
Missing output and dispatch dependencies return explicit errors without panicking
No protocol changes, new generic helpers, or lifecycle replacement during initialization

ownership.coordinator: Lifecycle production, new option tests, verification, and task evidence
ownership.adapter_worker: Adapter internal production and test migration

risks: Options must not invoke callbacks before requestor initialization finishes
Sender must resolve the current streamer rather than capture a nil or obsolete instance
Behavior is not available during requestor construction; failed loading must remain observable
Turn callbacks must remain synchronous and outside the state lock
Unconfigured expiry routing must not leave playback paused indefinitely
Existing unrelated worktree and prior lifecycle cleanup must remain intact

verification_results.test_migration_correction: Updated terminal-audio capture assertions to account for the initial audio sent through the injected sender and supplied missing send dependencies in EOS fixtures
verification_results.environment_note: Native linker warnings were non-fatal; no live provider or carrier tests were run

independent_review.summary: Verified lazy startup, lifecycle retention, live streamer binding, synchronous turn callback ordering, missing-dependency behavior, and regression coverage relative to the preceding event cleanup

rollback: Revert only constructor-option wiring, retaining the preceding lifecycle event and declaration cleanup
